description: Dragging a model further than it can move must hold it AT its maximum range instead of letting it run past into a drop the phase rejects. Part A (setting ON, the new default): the Blade Champion (M=6") is dragged 15" straight down over open board with the button still held (drag_board release:false) so the live drag frame can be inspected — the ghost must sit exactly 6.00" from the pickup point while the cursor is 15" away, the preview must read VALID, and mouse_up_board must stage a real 6.0" move. Part B (setting OFF): the identical drag must reproduce the historical free drag — ghost 15" out, preview invalid, and the drop rejected with nothing staged. Part C: the clamp costs terrain the way the phase does — the Telemon (M=8") dragged at a tall ruin it cannot afford to enter stops SHORT of the ruin at a distance the phase accepts, rather than at a geometric 8" the phase would reject for the climb cost. Part C is the regression that matters: MovementController used to omit the T-103 vertical-climb term MovementPhase charges, so clamping to the controller's own boundary produced a guaranteed-rejected drop.

steps.script:
# Part A setup: clamp ON (the default), and frame the board so the pickup
# point, the 6" reach circle and the far cursor are all on screen.
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(true)
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 1.4
m.view_offset = Vector2(120.0 - 760.0 / 1.4, 100.0 - 190.0 / 1.4)
m.update_view_transform()
return SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range
main.movement_controller.active_unit_id
main.movement_controller._get_effective_move_cap()
main.movement_controller.dragging_model
str(main.get_meta("clamp_probe"))

# Held at the cap means the preview reads LEGAL — the whole point is that the
# player never has to aim at the circle to get the full move.
var mc = tree.root.get_node("Main").movement_controller
var ghost = tree.root.get_node("Main").get_node("BoardRoot/MovementGhostVisual")
return mc.path_valid and mc._compute_move_rejection(ghost.position) == ""
PhaseManager.current_phase_instance.active_moves["U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"].staged_moves.size()

# The drop stages the FULL move, not a rejection: 6.0" of a 6.0" cap.
var md = PhaseManager.current_phase_instance.active_moves["U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"]
var d = float(md["model_distances"].get("U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A:m1", -1.0))
tree.root.get_node("Main").set_meta("staged_probe", "staged=%.3f\"" % d)
return abs(d - 6.0) <= 0.05
str(main.get_meta("staged_probe"))

# Part B: same drag with the setting OFF must reproduce the historical free
# drag. Reset the unit so it starts from the same board state.
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(false)
var pi = PhaseManager.current_phase_instance
pi.process_action({"type": "RESET_UNIT_MOVE", "actor_unit_id": "U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"})
return not SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range
main.movement_controller.active_unit_id
str(main.get_meta("unclamped_probe"))

# Over-range drop with the clamp off is rejected outright — nothing staged.
var pi = PhaseManager.current_phase_instance
if not pi.active_moves.has("U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"):
	return true
return pi.active_moves["U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"].get("staged_moves", []).size() == 0

# Part C: clamp back ON, and reframe on the Telemon (M=8") which sits above a
# tall ruin it cannot afford to climb into.
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(true)
var pi = PhaseManager.current_phase_instance
for uid in pi.active_moves.keys():
	pi.process_action({"type": "RESET_UNIT_MOVE", "actor_unit_id": uid})
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 1.2
m.view_offset = Vector2(600.0 - 930.0 / 1.2, 250.0 - 250.0 / 1.2)
m.update_view_transform()
return SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range
main.movement_controller.active_unit_id
str(main.get_meta("terrain_probe"))

# The regression: this drop used to be REJECTED because the controller's
# preview omitted the vertical-climb cost the phase charges. It must stage.
var pi = PhaseManager.current_phase_instance
if not pi.active_moves.has("U_TELEMON_HEAVY_DREADNOUGHT_I"):
	return false
return pi.active_moves["U_TELEMON_HEAVY_DREADNOUGHT_I"].get("staged_moves", []).size() == 1

# Leave the setting at its shipped default so a later scenario in the same run
# is not affected.
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(true)
return SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range
